summary: Clean same-commit llama.cpp c8e03ce81 XTX comparator packet. HIP wins standardized prefill and context-matched AR decode; Vulkan B4 wins natural MTP. Vulkan sets every lower matched memory ceiling.

protocol.standardized_ar: llama-bench split phase, one warmup, five internal repetitions, llama-bench avg_ts arithmetic mean reported with all samples and stddev, 5 ms sysfs VRAM
protocol.context_ar: llama-server token-repeat shape control, 129 visible outputs / 128 timed transitions, 5 ms sysfs VRAM
protocol.natural_mtp: ten prompts, all four categories, B1-B5, candidate-local process/warmup, 25 visible outputs / 24 timed transitions per prompt, true no-MTP control
protocol.margin_rule: Final hipEngine speed must exceed the faster comparator by at least 1%; memory must not exceed the lower comparator peak delta.

validation.note: The raw wrappers conservatively emit diagnostic_retained/performance_claim=false; this compact packet graduates only the externally validated comparator floors. Standardized AR captured while another change made the hipEngine worktree dirty, but the external binaries were tracked-clean and scripts/llamacpp_bench_with_peak.py is unchanged between harness commits 46d75dd80 and 6a8d38ae7. Context/MTP captures report clean harness state. The generic Vulkan provenance helper enumerated both global Vulkan GPUs and identified default HIP GPU0 as its device_name; the selected -dev Vulkan1 command, llama-bench GPU record, sysfs card0 PCI/unique-id, and process-memory sampler all identify the measured RX 7900 XTX.

decision.next: Implement one-payload Q4 residency against these immutable speed and memory targets.
